title: The Sanjivani Herb
translation: Bringing the Sanjivani herb, you revived Lakshmana; Rama, overjoyed, held you to his heart.
translation_hi: आपने संजीवनी बूटी लाकर लक्ष्मण को जीवित किया, जिससे श्री रघुवीर ने हर्षित होकर आपको हृदय से लगा लिया।
science: Medicinal plants are real lifesavers: about a quarter of modern medicines come from plant compounds, like aspirin from willow bark and artemisinin from sweet wormwood.
